## 🚀 What is LegalMind AI?

LegalMind AI is a complete, production-ready full-stack application that provides AI-powered legal assistance using advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology. Get instant answers to legal questions with verified source citations.

## ✨ Key Features

- 🤖 **AI-Powered Q&A** - GPT-4 with RAG for accurate legal information
- 📚 **Vector Search** - Semantic search using pgvector
- 💬 **Real-time Chat** - Conversational interface with history
- 📄 **Document Upload** - PDF analysis and processing
- 🔐 **Secure Auth** - JWT-based authentication
- 🎨 **Modern UI** - Beautiful, responsive design
- 📱 **Mobile Ready** - Works on all devices
- 🎯 **Source Citations** - Every answer includes references

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

**Frontend:** Next.js 15 • TypeScript • Tailwind CSS • Framer Motion

**Backend:** FastAPI • Python • SQLAlchemy • LangChain

**Database:** PostgreSQL • pgvector

**AI/ML:** OpenAI GPT-4 • Sentence Transformers
